title: Internal billing
description: Bill work between departments, projects and subsidiaries. Each rule decides how the movement stays out of company totals.

list.emptyDescription: Record work one part of the business does for another, so the right department, project or subsidiary is credited and charged.

drawer.description: Choose who provides the work and who receives it.
drawer.noRules: There are no internal billing rules yet. Add one in Setup → Internal billing.

void.title: Void internal billing
void.message: The posting is reversed. A line billed to a customer must be released by voiding or deleting that invoice first.

feedback.saveFailed: The draft could not be saved.
feedback.postFailed: The document could not be posted.
feedback.voidFailed: The document could not be voided.

revenue_credit.label: Department credit for the sale
revenue_credit.description: The department that did the work is credited with the revenue; company revenue is not counted twice.

cost_transfer.label: Cost transfer
cost_transfer.description: Move cost to the department or project that used the work; company cost is unchanged.

intercompany_sale.label: Intercompany sale
intercompany_sale.description: One subsidiary sells to another; both sides eliminate on consolidation.
